intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Safety Harbor for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from December 4 (the Safety Harbor Tree Lighting at the John Wilson Park gazebo) through December 12 (Harbor Holiday Nights at Folly Farm Nature Preserve, December 11 and 12), with the Safety Harbor Holiday Parade on Main Street (December 5) along the way. Harbor Holiday Nights has free admission, with optional ticketed children's activities. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Safety Harbor

  • 3 Christmas events for kids in Safety Harbor
  • 3 free events: the Tree Lighting (December 4), the Holiday Parade (December 5) and Harbor Holiday Nights (December 11 and 12, free admission, optional ticketed children's activities)
  • Meet Santa: Santa at the tree lighting (December 4), at the end of the Holiday Parade (December 5) and at Harbor Holiday Nights (ticketed, December 11 and 12)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Tree Lighting (Friday, December 4, 6 to 7:30 pm) and the Holiday Parade (Saturday, December 5, 10 to 11:30 am)
  • Trains: none in town; see the Largo page for the Rudolph Limited
  • Season: December 4 to December 12

Planning a bigger day out? Safety Harbor families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Tampa, which covers Busch Gardens Christmas Town, ZooTampa Lights and the Tampa Riverwalk boat parade.
